<script>
(function(){
  let shown = 0;
  const pills = ['p1','p2','p3'];
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    const s1 = document.querySelector('.s1');
    if (s1 && s1.offsetParent !== null && shown < pills.length) {
      document.getElementById(pills[shown]).classList.add('show');
      shown++;
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }, true);
})();
</script>

## {background-color="#F7F7F7"}

```{=html}
<!-- ══ SLIDE 4: K-MEDOIDS ══ -->
<div class="s4">
  <div class="s4-left">
    <div class="label">K-Medoids (PAM)</div>
    <div class="s4-title">A more robust<br>alternative</div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;color:#888;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:20px;">
      Unlike K-Means, the center must be a <strong style="color:#0A0A0A">real data point</strong> — not an average. More robust to outliers.
    </div>
    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step on" id="st0">
        <div class="step-n">1</div>
        <div class="step-txt"><strong>Pick medoids</strong><br>Choose K actual data points as centers</div>
      </div>
      <div class="step" id="st1">
        <div class="step-n">2</div>
        <div class="step-txt"><strong>Assign points</strong><br>Each point → nearest medoid</div>
      </div>
      <div class="step" id="st2">
        <div class="step-n">3</div>
        <div class="step-txt"><strong>Swap medoids</strong><br>Try each non-medoid as a replacement; keep if cost decreases</div>
      </div>
      <div class="step" id="st3">
        <div class="step-n">4</div>
        <div class="step-txt"><strong>Repeat</strong><br>Until no swap improves the solution</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s4-right">
    <canvas id="kc" width="880" height="620"></canvas>
    <div class="s4-btns">
      <button class="btn btn-p" onclick="kNext()">Next Step ▶</button>
      <button class="btn btn-s" onclick="kReset()">Reset</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const CLR=['#06C167','#00B4D8','#FF6B35'], BG='#F7F7F7';
  let pts=[], asgn=[], medoids=[], phase=0;

  function d(a,b){ return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y); }

  function totalCost(meds, assignments){
    return pts.reduce((s,p,i) => s + d(p, meds[assignments[i]]), 0);
  }

  function assign(meds){
    return pts.map(p => {
      let best=0, bd=Infinity;
      meds.forEach((m,k)=>{ const dd=d(p,m); if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=k;} });
      return best;
    });
  }

  function gen(){
    pts=[];
    [[220,195,60,50],[595,165,70,60],[415,435,80,55]].forEach(([cx,cy,sx,sy])=>{
      for(let i=0;i<33;i++) pts.push({
        x: cx+(Math.random()-.5)*2*sx,
        y: cy+(Math.random()-.5)*2*sy,
        c: '#CCCCCC', isMedoid: false
      });
    });
    // Add a visible outlier to motivate robustness
    pts.push({x:780, y:80, c:'#CCCCCC', isMedoid:false});
    pts.push({x:820, y:150, c:'#CCCCCC', isMedoid:false});
    asgn = new Array(pts.length).fill(-1);
    medoids = [];
    phase = 0;
  }

  function pickInitialMedoids(){
    // Pick 3 random pts as initial medoids
    const idx = [];
    while(idx.length < 3){
      const r = Math.floor(Math.random()*pts.length);
      if(!idx.includes(r)) idx.push(r);
    }
    medoids = idx.map(i => ({...pts[i], idx: i}));
    pts.forEach(p => p.isMedoid = false);
    idx.forEach(i => pts[i].isMedoid = true);
  }

  function doAssign(){
    asgn = assign(medoids);
    pts.forEach((p,i) => { p.c = CLR[asgn[i]]; });
  }

  function doSwap(){
    // One round of PAM swap
    let bestCost = totalCost(medoids, asgn);
    let bestMeds = medoids.map(m=>({...m}));
    let improved = false;

    for(let k=0; k<medoids.length; k++){
      for(let i=0; i<pts.length; i++){
        if(medoids.some(m=>m.idx===i)) continue;
        const trialMeds = medoids.map((m,j) => j===k ? {...pts[i], idx:i} : {...m});
        const trialAsgn = assign(trialMeds);
        const trialCost = totalCost(trialMeds, trialAsgn);
        if(trialCost < bestCost){
          bestCost = trialCost;
          bestMeds = trialMeds;
          improved = true;
        }
      }
    }
    pts.forEach(p => p.isMedoid = false);
    medoids = bestMeds;
    medoids.forEach(m => { pts[m.idx].isMedoid = true; });
    doAssign();
    return improved;
  }

  function draw(){
    const cv=document.getElementById('kc'); if(!cv)return;
    const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'), W=cv.width, H=cv.height;
    ctx.fillStyle=BG; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // Grid
    ctx.strokeStyle='#E8E8E8'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=55){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke();}
    for(let y=0;y<=H;y+=55){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke();}

    // Voronoi regions
    if(phase>=2 && medoids.length){
      const step=12;
      for(let px=0;px<W;px+=step) for(let py=0;py<H;py+=step){
        let best=0,bd=Infinity;
        medoids.forEach((m,k)=>{ const dd=d({x:px,y:py},m); if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=k;} });
        ctx.fillStyle=CLR[best]+'0D'; ctx.fillRect(px,py,step,step);
      }
    }

    // Connection lines from medoid to assigned points
    if(phase>=2 && medoids.length){
      medoids.forEach((m,k)=>{
        pts.forEach((p,i)=>{
          if(asgn[i]===k && !p.isMedoid){
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.x,m.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
            ctx.strokeStyle=CLR[k]+'18'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke();
          }
        });
      });
    }

    // Regular points
    pts.forEach((p,i)=>{
      if(p.isMedoid) return;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,5.5,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle=p.c; ctx.fill();
      if(p.c!=='#CCCCCC'){ ctx.strokeStyle=p.c+'50'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke(); }
    });

    // Medoids — drawn as diamonds to distinguish from K-Means crosses
    medoids.forEach((m,k)=>{
      const sz=14;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(m.x, m.y-sz);
      ctx.lineTo(m.x+sz, m.y);
      ctx.lineTo(m.x, m.y+sz);
      ctx.lineTo(m.x-sz, m.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle='#F7F7F7'; ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle=CLR[k]; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=CLR[k]; ctx.font='bold 10px -apple-system,sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillText(['M1','M2','M3'][k], m.x, m.y+4);
    });

    // Status
    const msgs=['','3 medoids selected (real data points ◇)','Points assigned to nearest medoid','Medoids swapped to minimize total distance','Converged ✓  Medoids are stable'];
    if(msgs[phase]){
      ctx.fillStyle='#04a356'; ctx.font='600 13px -apple-system,sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.fillText(msgs[phase],20,H-16);
    }
  }

  function setStep(n){
    [0,1,2,3].forEach(i=>{
      const el=document.getElementById('st'+i);
      if(el) el.classList.toggle('on', i===n);
    });
  }

  window.kNext=function(){
    if(phase===0){ pickInitialMedoids(); phase=1; setStep(0); }
    else if(phase===1){ doAssign(); phase=2; setStep(1); }
    else if(phase===2){ doSwap(); phase=3; setStep(2); }
    else if(phase===3){ doSwap(); phase=4; setStep(3); }
    draw();
  };
  window.kReset=function(){ gen(); setStep(0); draw(); };

  gen(); draw();
})();
</script>
```
